title: Core Set 2020 Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Sephara, Sky's Blade
entities.description: A speaker who offers words on courage and life.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of choices creating the future and of weeping a torrent that scours the land clean.

entities.name: Krinnea
entities.description: The author of Siege of the Bone Spire.

entities.name: Siege of the Bone Spire
entities.description: A written work by Krinnea describing knights riding out from a bone-white keep against a queen's soldiers.

entities.name: Modriss
entities.description: A figure from Zargoth Fen who is enthusiastic about a zombie.

entities.name: Kethis, the Hidden Hand
entities.description: A schemer who speaks of dividing things "fairly" and claims the pen is mightier than the crown.

entities.name: Marsden
entities.description: A party leader whose last words were shouting at his party to spread out.

entities.name: Thaedus the Clever
entities.description: A figure whose last words were a calculation about a dragon's strafing run.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of the forest creating its own protectors.

entities.name: Khalni
entities.description: A druidic group to which Horent belongs.

entities.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
entities.description: A being who grieves within the waste of Bala Ged's corrupted land.

entities.name: Lament for Bala Ged
entities.description: A poem lamenting Bala Ged and Yarok's grief.

entities.name: Constable Trosk
entities.description: A constable who advises burying the dead properly.

entities.name: Sargis Haz
entities.description: An artificer who believes the world is run by machines.

events.summary: In Siege of the Bone Spire, knights riding from the bone-white keep sap the courage of the queen's soldiers.
events.quote: "With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."

events.summary: Marsden, a party leader, dies shouting at his party to spread out.
events.quote: "Spread out, you idiots! Spread out!" —Marsden, party leader, last words

events.summary: Thaedus the Clever dies mid-calculation about a dragon's strafing run.
events.quote: "I have calculated that a dragon in flight, in a single strafing run, can cover an area of—" —Thaedus the Clever, last words

events.summary: Yarok grieves within the corrupted waste of Bala Ged.
events.quote: "Yarok grieves within the waste Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."

relations.quote: "Yarok grieves within the waste Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
